title: Add degraded-state explainer and evidence path actions
purpose: Make degraded state actionable by explaining cause, authority, impact and evidence paths.
scope: Render degraded state causes from runtime, support bundle, AOM and release evidence.
Show impact and safe next action for each degraded state.
Show evidence artifact paths or ids for operator handoff.
Provide typed commands for export or view, not shell open.
Add redaction and path safety tests.
acceptance_criteria: Degraded state includes cause, impact, source and next action.
Evidence paths are safe to display and do not expose secrets.
Optional dependency degradation does not block baseline operation.
No shell open or host file manager shortcut is introduced.
failure_modes: Degraded state is hidden behind healthy status.
Evidence path action becomes arbitrary file open.
Optional dependency warning is treated as fatal baseline failure.
